headline: Recommended sending the Reimagining Franklin Street redesign to the City Council.
summary: The meeting heard a panel on the Central Main Power transmission line and reviewed the Reimagining Franklin Street design. Members recommended the Franklin Street design to the City Council. The Vision Zero update was moved to the next meeting.
decisions: Recommended sending the Reimagining Franklin Street design concept to the City Council, with yes votes recorded on the roll call.
discussion: Central Main Power transmission line: Panelists described the need for grid upgrades, a route along existing corridors, and a project cost of $547 million. Others asked whether underground routing along Interstate 295 or other alternatives could reduce impacts.

Franklin Street design concerns: Members and public speakers discussed traffic lanes and turning lanes, median strips, the Boyd Street garden expansion, Lincoln Park size, and bike and pedestrian safety at Marginal Way.
Vision Zero update postponed: The Mayor asked to postpone the Vision Zero update so more time could go to the median strip ordinance, and the update was moved to the November 18 meeting.
Stradora Dam study: Staff said they plan to pursue grant funding for a study scope and bring it back to the committee. No vote was taken.

decision_evidence.quote: And I will take a motion to move the reimagined Franklin Arterial to the city council. So moved. Second. Moved by Councilor Bullitt, second by Councilor Ali. And now we'll go to vote Councilor Lee. Yes. Councilor Bullitt. Well. And I'm a yes.
